The examples of the "Autolinks (extension)" section of the GitHub Flavored
Markdown Spec, version 0.29-gfm (2019-04-06), from
[github/cmark-gfm](https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/27d942c/test/spec.txt)
at commit 27d942c, with the spec's `→` written as a tab.

The spec is by John MacFarlane and GitHub, under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/),
and so is `autolinks.json`, which adapts it.
